d:
After getting his beloved scooter Sakharam back, Bhide, along with Madhavi and Sonu, goes door-to-door across Gokuldham Society distributing flowers and sweets to thank everyone for their help—including Abdul, Dr. Hathi, Taarak, Sodhi, Jethalal, Babita & Iyer, and Popatlal (who comically frets when the roses run out).
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
